title: My Birthday Cake
description: Three short recordings about birthday cakes: a birthday at home, baking a cake and a party.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Happy birthday!
parts.intro: You will hear Mai and her dad.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Happy birthday, Mai! Are you seven today?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes, Dad! I'm seven. Where is my cake?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Here it is. It's a chocolate cake.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yummy! I wanted a strawberry cake, but chocolate is good.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Look at the candles. How many can you see?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I can see seven candles. They are pink and blue.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Now make a wish, Mai, and blow out the candles.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I wish for a puppy! Thank you, Dad. This is the best day.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Happy birthday again, my girl. Let's eat the cake now.

parts.title: Part 2 · Making a cake
parts.intro: You will hear Ben and his mum.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Ben, let's make a cake for Grandma.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Yes! What do we need?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: We need eggs, milk and sugar.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: I have the eggs. Is the milk on the table?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: No, it's in the fridge.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Can I put the sugar in?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Yes, but be careful.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Good. Now we put the cake in the oven for one hour.

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: I can smell it already! I love baking with you, Mum.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Me too. Grandma will be very happy.

parts.title: Part 3 · My party
parts.intro: You will hear a boy called Tom.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Hello! Today is my party. My friends come at three o'clock.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: We eat cake and play games. We go home at four o'clock.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I have a big red balloon. My friend Linh gives me a present. It is a book.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: We sing a song and I blow out the candles. It is a happy day.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: My cake is big and very sweet. I love my party.

questions.explanation: Dad and Mai say she is seven.

questions.text: What kind of cake is it?
questions.explanation: Dad says it is a chocolate cake. Mai wanted strawberry.
Yes. She says "Yummy!" and "chocolate is good".
Mum says they make a cake for Grandma.
Mum says the milk is in the fridge, not on the table.

questions.text: What does Ben put in the cake?
questions.explanation: Ben asks to put the sugar in and Mum says yes.

evidence.quote: Can I put the sugar in?

questions.text: What time do the friends come?
questions.explanation: The friends come at three o'clock. Four o'clock is when they go home.

evidence.quote: My friends come at three o'clock
